chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man in his late twenties with a short black beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman wearing a dark green hijab and a long cream knitted cardigan over a black dress
chars.MOTHERINLAW: an older Moroccan woman wearing a maroon djellaba and a white headscarf
chars.FRIEND: a young Moroccan man wearing a red tracksuit with white stripes

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan apartment living room in Casablanca, WIFE stands with arms crossed, her face suddenly cold and hostile, turning away; HUSBAND stands in front of her stunned, hand half raised, shocked expression. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, subjects centred.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND walks out of a Moroccan family court building holding a folder of papers, sad tired face, white-washed facade with green tiles behind him, daytime. Subject centred, head to knees.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND sits alone at a Casablanca café terrace table with a coffee, looking thoughtfully at a smiling couple passing in the street, calm resolute expression. Subject centred.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND talks seriously to FRIEND on a Moroccan rooftop terrace, pointing a finger as he gives advice, FRIEND listening attentively, laundry lines and satellite dishes in the background. Both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: WIFE and MOTHERINLAW whisper together in a Moroccan kitchen, MOTHERINLAW leaning close and scheming, WIFE glancing sideways with a sly look. Head-to-waist framing, faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan salon, MOTHERINLAW holds out her open hand demanding money, HUSBAND firmly pushes a cash envelope back toward himself and shakes his head, tense moment. Both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND sits on the edge of a bed holding a framed wedding photo, looking at it with sad nostalgic eyes, soft evening light from a window. Subject centred.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND stands on a Casablanca apartment balcony at dusk, looking out over the city rooftops, thoughtful and calm, orange sky. Subject centred, seen from slightly behind at three-quarter angle with face visible.
